subject: humanities
passage: Acousticians describe a room's reverberation time as the number of seconds a sound takes to fade by sixty decibels after its source stops. A long reverberation time, around two seconds or more, lets the notes of choral or organ music blend into a rich, continuous sound, which is one reason many large stone churches are prized as venues for such music. ______ a short reverberation time, closer to one second, suits speech and drama, since each syllable fades before the next one can blur it.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

explanation.why: The second sentence says a long reverberation time suits blended music. The last sentence states the reverse case: a short reverberation time suits speech. The transition must introduce the opposite side of the same relationship.
explanation.A: Incorrect. "Nevertheless" signals that something is true in spite of what came before, but short reverberation suiting speech does not go against long reverberation suiting choral music. This is the closest near miss.
explanation.B: Incorrect. "Similarly" signals a parallel point, but the last sentence describes the opposite case, not a matching one.
explanation.C: Correct. "Conversely" signals that the last sentence reverses the previous case: short instead of long, speech instead of choral music.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A short reverberation time for speech is not an example of a long reverberation time suiting music.
